content: 1. Erythromycin ethylsuccinate reduces the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to oral forms of the hormone. The risk of contraceptive failure is low, but caution and monitoring are advised. An alternative or additional form of birth control may be recommended during concurrent use. 2. Erythromycin ethylsuccinate can also increase the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate by affecting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Adverse effects such as nausea, irregular uterine bleeding, breast tenderness, and headache should be monitored. 3.
